statement: A GitHub Actions workflow that writes a commit with the repository GITHUB_TOKEN must not assume that commit's ordinary push event will trigger a dependent workflow; required deterministic downstream transformations must run in the same workflow transaction or use an explicit supported dispatch mechanism.

scope.notes: Scoped to GitHub Actions event triggering; does not claim that all explicit dispatch/token mechanisms are non-recursive.

assumptions.statement: The write/event is produced using the repository GITHUB_TOKEN rather than an independently configured credential or explicit dispatch mechanism.

review.rationale: Migrated conservatively from a validated Foundry bug with both observed repository behavior and official GitHub trigger documentation.
